main_text.p: וַתִּצָּנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר Et defiliit de afino, Jud.1.14.
צנםf. Gracilis: Tenuis. Plur. שִׁבֳּלִים צְנוּמוֹת Spicæ graciles, Gen.41.23.

צנןf. Clypeus, Scutum, Umbo: 1.Reg.10.16. Semel ex Chaldaica significatione, Frigus. Constr. כְּצִנַּת שֶׁלֶג Sicut frigus nivis, Prov.25:13. Plur. צִנּוֹת Clypei, 2.Par.11.12. Et secundum aliam significationem Aculei, Hami: בְּצִנּוֹת Aculeis, Hamis aculeatis; Amos 4.2.
צנעHiph. הִצְנִיעַ Humiliter, modeste agere: Infinit. הַצְנֵעַ Modeste agendo, Mich.6.8. Chaldæis & Rabbinis frequens est.
צנףCircumvolvit, Volutavit: Obvolvit; Obtexit: Infinit. צָנוֹף יְצַנְּפֶךָּ Volutando volutabit te, Jesa.22.18. Futur. יִצְנוֹף Obtegitor, Lev.16:4.
צניףm. Cidaris, à Circumvolvendo, Zach.3.5. Constructe. וְצָנִיף מְלוּכָה Et cidaris regni, Jesa.62.3. Plural: צְנִיפוֹת Jesa.3.v.22.
צנצנתf. Urna, Exod.16.33. Utrumque Targum reddit צְלוֹחִית Paropsis, Scutella. R.David deducit à צנן.

צנקצִנַּק m. Nervus, Vinculum; juxta R.Sal. quo pedes vel etiam cervices impediuntur: vel Manicæ, Vincula manuum, juxta R.D.Kimchi, Jerem.29.26. Sunt qui compositum nomen existiment ex צִי & יָנַק quasi Naviculam fugentem dicas. Refert autem Plutarchus in Artaxerxe, fuisse olim cruciatus seu carceris quoddam genus,

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are only partly legible in the scan; the vocalised forms (e.g. צִנַּת, צְנוּמוֹת, צָנוֹף, צְנִיפוֹת) are copied as best seen and may carry small point errors. The left-margin headwords (צנם, צנן, צנים, צנינים, צנע, צנועים, צנף, צניף, צנפה, מצנפת, צנצנת, צנק) are entry headings set in the margin and are given as notes beside their entries. The final line is cut at the bottom of the column and continues on the next page.
